以下 B01–B05 在独立业务测试模型配置可用后执行；缺模型时逐项记 blocked，继续完成资料、权限、助手接入和未配置状态的搭建，不用固定回复替代真实调用。

B05. 询问资料中没有的“设备免费更换年限”，助手说明缺少依据，不编造年限。

B06. 在测试环境提供的服务不可用条件下，界面显示真实不可用状态，手工资料页仍可打开；没有该测试条件时单独记录未执行。

modules.name: AI 员工工具与员工登记
modules.scope: 审查应用如何借助 @nocobase/ai-employee 与 @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee 登记后端工具与 AI 员工（观察点：read-materials 工具、materials-assistant 员工），以及 Skill 对登记契约与职责边界的指引。
modules.limitations: 仅核对登记路径与公共入口；未验证离线环境下技能加载失败时的行为，也未覆盖多员工/多工具的压测。

requirements.need: 应用自有的后端工具与 AI 员工要能在插件之后登记，并与插件内置资源共存。
requirements.responsibility: 插件提供 AIResourceRegistrar/AIEmployeeResources 生命周期与 aiManagerToken；@nocobase/ai-employee 提供 registerTools/registerEmployee。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 应用继承 AIResourceRegistrar 并在 Provider.boot() 解析 aiManagerToken 后调用 registerAIResources()。
requirements.actualUsage: MaterialsAIResources 覆写 registerTools/registerAIEmployees，登记 readMaterialsTool 与 materials-assistant（app/server/ai/index.ts）。

requirements.need: 工具声明需包含 scope/execution/dependencies，并只暴露统一登记入口。
requirements.responsibility: @nocobase/ai-employee 的 defineTools 与 DefaultToolsManager。
requirements.recommendedUsage: backend 工具用 SPECIFIED scope 声明依赖的 service token，工具本体只做参数校验。
requirements.actualUsage: read-materials 用 defineTools + materialsServiceToken，经 MaterialsService 读数据。

requirements.need: 扩展只能从公共入口与 token 接入，不能深引内部路径或重复造 token。
requirements.responsibility: 插件公共 entrypoints 与 tokens.js 提供稳定导入面；Skill 说明职责边界。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 从创建 token 的包导入，公共入口与 token 成对使用。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用从 @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/server 导入 AIResourceRegistrar 与 aiManagerToken，未深引 dist 内部路径。

requirements.need: B01/B02/B05 的真实问答与引用依赖可用的 LLM 服务。
requirements.responsibility: 环境/工厂需提供独立业务测试模型。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 启动前配置 ai.llmServices 并用 models/test 验证可用。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 llmServices 为空（llmServices: 0），助手页显示未配置模型，QA 记 B01–B05 blocked。

requirementFit.reason: 登记契约与 Skill 职责划分清晰，应用按推荐方式接入；端到端问答因缺模型未能确认。

usability.reason: 登记入口单一、Skill 给出 ownership 表，接入成本低；工具调用期的调试仍需自行读日志。

agentFriendliness.reason: 生命周期与 token 语义显式，Agent 可按 Skill 顺序落地而不必猜测内部结构。

design.reason: 注册器分层合理：插件管内置、应用覆写扩展、token 与类同文件声明，边界清楚。

reliability.reason: 登记流程有日志与统一 normalize，应用实现在修复轮后可重复运行；未覆盖技能加载失败路径。

modules.name: 业务授权与记录范围
modules.scope: 审查 @nocobase/authorization 的记录范围/复合资源抽象、@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization 的权限声明与内置记录范围，以及授权 Skill 与业务权限集的映射。
modules.limitations: 未运行授权插件的完整测试套件，也未评估高并发下策略解析性能；拒绝路径仅借助 B00 的 404 结果与静态实现核对。

requirements.need: 用命名记录范围与复合资源表达「同事仅见非受限、主管全部」。
requirements.responsibility: authorization 提供 defineRecordAccess/defineCompositeResource 及其登记器。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 声明带 collections 的 record access，并用 composite 把 view/manage 动作绑定到授权引用。
requirements.actualUsage: visibleMaterialsAccess + materialsComposite，view→materialsRead、manage→materialsWrite。

requirements.need: 权限集按职责把 view/manage 绑定到不同数据范围。
requirements.responsibility: 权限集种子与 app-plugin-authorization 的数据范围。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 主管用 allRecords，同事用命名的 materials.visible。
requirements.actualUsage: materials-supervisor（view/manage allRecords）与 materials-colleague（view materials.visible）。

requirements.need: HTTP 路由与助手工具共享同一授权上下文与 Policy。
requirements.responsibility: 应用服务构造 AuthorizationContext 并用 withPolicy 查询。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 非 HTTP actor 用 authorization.for(principal, subjects.resolveFor(...))，并复用同一 readPolicy。
requirements.actualUsage: MaterialsService.contextFor/list 与页面路由共用 MaterialsService，助手工具也走该服务。

requirements.need: 把记录范围解析为按字段类型合法的过滤节点（boolean 需 $isFalsy）。
requirements.responsibility: app-plugin-authorization 的字面量 condition + @nocobase/db 的按类型算子校验。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 布尔字段用 $isTruly/$isFalsy，不要用 $eq。
requirements.actualUsage: materials.visible 用 condition('restricted','$isFalsy') 并附注释说明 db 拒绝 $eq；但指引未写明该限制。

requirements.need: B00/B02 的记录隔离与拒绝语义。
requirements.responsibility: 授权策略 + 记录范围 + 验收脚本。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 拒绝时返回不泄露存在性的 404，并覆盖列表与直读接口。
requirements.actualUsage: B00 已验证同事列表/详情/直读均拒绝资料 C（MATERIAL_NOT_FOUND）；B02 的助手侧因缺模型 blocked。

requirementFit.reason: 记录范围与权限集表达力足以覆盖业务需求，B00 隔离已验证；B02 的助手链路未验证。

usability.reason: 命名 record access 与 composite 可读性好，但 condition 字面量的字段类型约束缺少指引，容易踩坑。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 给出明确的落地顺序与验证要求，登记器对重复定义快速报错，便于 Agent 自我纠错。

design.reason: record access 与 composite 分层清晰，subject 解析与请求上下文等价，重复登记与非法 scope 均在 define 期拦截。

reliability.reason: 登记与解析路径有结构化校验与明确错误类型；未覆盖并发与缓存场景。

modules.name: Repository 策略与过滤算子
modules.scope: 审查 @nocobase/db 的 Policy 绑定读写路径、按字段类型的算子校验与迁移声明，以及 nocobase-db Skill 对过滤算子的指引。

evidence.observation: AIResourceRegistrar 生命周期的公开契约：registerAIResources 依次调用 registerTools→loadSkills→registerAIEmployees，并在每个阶段后记录日志；注释明确这是 application-owned AI resources 的生命周期边界。
AIEmployeeResources 继承 AIResourceRegistrar，把插件内置 skills 目录标为 plugin-built-in 并追加调用方目录，再覆写 registerAIEmployees/registerTools 登记内置员工与工具。
DefaultToolsManager.registerTools 接受单个或数组，经 normalizeToolsEntity 后 createOrUpdateTools，登记接口对调用方只暴露统一入口。
DefaultAIEmployeeManager.registerEmployee 委托 registerEmployeeInRepository，登记员工与切换仓储解耦。
defineAIEmployee 是身份函数，返回原 options，说明员工定义是纯数据契约而非需要实例化的对象。
tokens.js 在类旁边声明 aiManagerToken/agentServiceFactoryToken/managerFactoryToken/repositoryFactoryToken/serviceFactoryToken，注释说明 token 要在类存在前可读取。
插件公共入口从各自模块再导出 AIResourceRegistrar/AIEmployeeResources、defineAIConfig、AIConversationsManager 与 token，调用方无需深引内部路径。
Skill 的 ownership 表逐项界定 App 与 Plugin 的职责：App 拥有员工、后端工具、skill、config.yml、页面、业务授权与调用时机；Plugin 拥有聊天传输、会话持久化、工具审批、内置工具与 LLM provider。
evidence.excerpt:
## Ownership

```text
App owns       employees, backend tools, skills, config.yml, page composition,
               business collections, business authorization, invocation timing,
               any LLM provider it adds
Plugin owns    chat transport and SSE, conversation persistence, tool approval,
               attachment parsing, built-in tools, skills and LLM providers,
               /api/aiEmployees and /api/aiEmployee
Public entry   @nocobase/ai-employee root, @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/server,
               pnpm nocobase ai-employee models/test,
               the nocobase-ai Registry item installed at client/extensions/nocobase-ai
Do not bypass  plugin server/agent source paths, @nocobase/ai-employee/src/*,
               the synchronized copy under .agents/skills/
```

An importable subpath is not a runtime contribution. `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/server` exports tokens and the registrar base class; importing it never registers anything. Registration happens in the App's own Provider, once, in `boot()`.

Import a token from the package that created it. `createServiceToken` is keyed by object identity, so a second `createServiceToken('ai-manager')` is a different key that resolves nothing.

evidence.excerpt:
## Implement in this order

1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

evidence.excerpt:
**Query** knows tables and columns, not Collections: it does not read Collection metadata, does not honor Collection-level naming overrides, applies no policy or optimistic locking, and performs no relation-aware CRUD.

```ts
const rows = await db
  .query()
  .selectFrom('orders')
  .select(['id', 'orderNo', 'createdAt'])
  .where('status', '=', 'paid')
  .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
  .limit(20)
  .execute();
```

Terminating methods are `execute()`, `executeTakeFirst()` and `executeTakeFirstOrThrow()`, plus the shorthands `value(column)`, `pluck(column)` and `exists()`.

Conditions are three-argument — `where(lhs, operator, rhs)` — or a callback taking the expression builder for anything composite. There is no two-argument `where(field, value)`, and none of Knex's `orWhere()`, `whereIn()`, `whereNull()`, `orOn()` or `orOnRef()` exist here. Values are parameterized; never build SQL by string concatenation.

`updateTable` and `deleteFrom` refuse to run without a `where`. Affecting every row requires an explicit `allowAllRows()`, because an omitted `where` is unrecoverable in production.

evidence.excerpt:
# The one rule that decides everything

**A namespace is a package name, and the namespace in scope follows the render tree.**

An application's pages get the application's namespace; a plugin's pages get that plugin's, because the host wraps each contribution using the `packageName` it already records. So a component in its own package's routes translates with no namespace at all.

The exception is what most mistakes come from: a component a plugin exports for the application to render is in the _application's_ scope, not its own. It has to name its namespace.

evidence.excerpt:
## The readiness gate

`NocoBaseAIRootProvider` starts employee and model discovery asynchronously and does **not** defer mounting its children. A chat initialized before discovery finishes shows fallback defaults while its internal selection and transport still reflect an empty configuration, and the first send fails or silently uses nothing. A loading overlay over an already-mounted chat does not fix this, because the chat has already initialized underneath it.

So gate the whole `AIChatProvider` subtree from a child component that reads `useAI()` under the root, and check the three signals separately — `configurationStatus` can be `'ready'` while model discovery failed, and `models` can hold a `configured: false` placeholder, so neither status nor array length alone proves the chat can send.

evidence.excerpt:
Use the App's real import alias and localize the messages. If a root AI provider already wraps the route, mount `ConfiguredChat` under it rather than nesting a second root. Call hooks unconditionally before the guards return. An inline chat takes no controller: a controller starts closed, and a chat whose controller is never opened keeps its conversations marked unread. `!employees.length` guards employees passed in as a prop; when discovery finds none it reports `configurationStatus: 'error'` instead. Do not key the chat by employee or model to force re-initialization — that discards conversation state. Recovery from a configuration error is a page reload, not an employee or model switch.

`defaultEmployee` is not optional in practice. Without it the chat opens on `employees[0]`, which is the lowest `sort` across every enabled employee — and the built-in `atlas` ships with `sort: 0`, so a page built to talk to the App's own employee opens on the router instead. The readiness gate passes either way and the first send works, so nothing looks wrong; the conversation is just with the wrong assistant. Pass the username explicitly.
